verdict.rationale: Sift explicitly documents distinct abuse-specific coverage — Account Takeover, Account Abuse (fake accounts), Promotion Abuse, and Payment Protection — all scored and managed through the same Events/Decisions/Workflows/Review Queues system rather than siloed tools. Runtime probes confirm the shared Events API is live, and community evidence corroborates real-world use for fraud/account risk decisioning. Missing for 10: independent case-study evidence specifically showing promo-abuse or fake-account-creation workflows in production (most concrete detail comes from vendor docs).
